faq.title: Still have questions?
faq.ctaText: Request a demo to see how BelgoBase can help with your Belgian company selection.
faq.q1: How quickly can we get started?
faq.a1: After your request, we will contact you to arrange a suitable time for a demo.
faq.q2: Where does the data come from?
faq.a2: BelgoBase uses available Belgian company information, including KBO data and, where available, financial information from NBB sources.
faq.a3: BelgoBase is intended for professional B2B users. Read the privacy statement and use data only for a lawful purpose.
faq.q4: Can I choose my own criteria?
faq.a4: Yes. Filter by sector, region, legal form, company age, revenue, employee count, NACE codes, payroll signals, and more.
faq.a5: Yes. You will receive an official invoice for €2,500 excl. VAT for the one-time purchase of BelgoBase. There are no monthly or recurring fees.
faq.a6: You can use your own criteria and exclusions when building a selection.
faq.a7: You can export selected results to Excel.
faq.q8: Do you cover all of Belgium?
faq.a8: BelgoBase focuses on Belgian companies; available data can differ by company.
faq.q9: Can I see the platform before committing?
faq.a9: Yes. Request a demo and we will show the process with a suitable example.
